lineas.texto: Part two. The light under the water came from a tunnel nobody had entered in forty years.
It didn't move. It just waited, right below the surface.
I wasn't alone in the pocket. Ramon, from my crew, had crawled in on the first night.
On day six, our water was gone. And every night, the light came a little closer.
Ramon said: that's a diver. If we wait, we die here.
He took off his boots and slid into the water. His lamp went down toward the light.
Both lights went out together. Then the light came back. Only one.
And it started knocking. Three knocks. Our signal. Calling me down.
